The real L owner emits no eventContractDigest member (store:1215-1217,2495-2509) and rejects any explicit stamp in an L schedule (store:3483-3487).

The preimage cold join at lines 616-617 stripped only the three envelope members and hashed the entire L observation, so this is introduced by the new selector, not an inherited historical rejection.

The passing assertion at 839-844 proves that synthetic shape, while the real store forbids it. The current real-store admission in the test is only P. 113 retained passes are real bounded mechanical evidence, not proof of this omitted L relation.
